What is the default total concurrency limit for Lambda functions in an AWS account?

Reference answer:
1,000 concurrent executions across all functions in a Region, by default.

The default total concurrency limit for Lambda functions in an AWS account is 1,000 units of concurrency [Source 1]. This limit applies at the account level and represents the maximum number of simultaneous executions that your Lambda functions can handle across all functions in your account.

> "At the account level, your functions can have up to 1,000 units of concurrency by default." [Source 1]

To summarize, the default total concurrency limit for Lambda functions in an AWS account is 1,000 units of concurrency. If you need to handle more concurrent executions, you can request a quota increase from AWS.
